import json, time, importlib.util, cProfile, pstats, io
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
for fn in ("hard_case2.json", "hard_case3.json"):
    obj = json.load(open(fn))
    t0=time.time(); res = m.compile_request(obj); el=time.time()-t0
    out = json.loads(res)
    print("%s: total %.2fs states %d outlen %d" % (fn, el, len(out["dfa"]["accept"]), len(res)))
    pr = cProfile.Profile(); pr.enable(); m.compile_request(obj); pr.disable()
    s = io.StringIO(); pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('tottime').print_stats(10)
    print(s.getvalue()[:1800])
EOF
